evidence.text: PLS reached FID on its P2000 Pilgangoora expansion on 2026-10-16, after TOMRA's consensus was compiled (2026-10-14). That firms up the pre-FID award to TOMRA Mining of 22 XRT ore sorters ('the world's largest sensor-based sorting plant', first reported 2026-08-24/25). Recycling order intake or after-quarter order commentary should therefore exceed a consensus (56, max 59) that does not appear to include it.

evidence.why_not_priced: Consensus Recycling order intake (avg 56, median 58, max 59) is flat on Q2's 58, so no contributor added a 22-sorter order on top. If it were priced, the Recycling order estimates would sit well above Q2. The contract value is not public, which caps the size.

evidence.text: Volvo Cars said it will present 'further decisive actions' to accelerate its strategic roadmap with the Q3 report. This is the one scheduled new item in the release, landing on a stock down 29.8% in 60 days with a hiring freeze for white-collar staff already reported.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: Cost actions have been the stock's positive catalyst: Q2 2026 reported SEK 5bn savings six months early yet fell 10.8% on the outlook, while Q2 2025 (+7.9%) and Q3 2025 (+38.1%) came after the 2025 cost and headcount programme. Mixed
evidence.why_not_priced: The content is unknown until the release. If the market had already credited a large restructuring, the stock would not have kept making listing lows after the warning; it closed 14.27 on 22 Oct against 14.18 on the warning day. Restructuring charges could hit reported EBIT, so the sign is uncertain and the range is wide.
evidence.independence: EFN (2 Oct) expects further belt-tightening and reports a hiring freeze for white-collar staff and new rules on recruitment, consultants and purchased services: https://efn.se/jonathan-axelsson-ett-nytt-forlorat-ar-for-volvo-cars

evidence.text: EX60 output at Torslanda has run at about one-tenth of the ~2,000-a-week plan, with GlobalData-estimated sales of ~500 in July and ~250 in August and US deliveries pushed to H1 2027. Q2 FCF was already SEK -5.2bn on the EX60 inventory build, so Q3 cash flow and the ramp commentary are the likeliest negative surprise lines.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 printed FCF of SEK -5.2bn alongside a 1.1% EBIT margin and the stock fell 10.8% on the day. Cash has been part of the negative report days
evidence.why_not_priced: The cash hit was flagged qualitatively but not sized. Handelsbanken called the warning only 'partly expected' and cited the weak EX60 uptake. A tape that had fully priced a deep cash burn would not have bounced 4.4% on 20 Oct. The finding is partly priced, so it is sized small.
